heading: Unique Features We Embed in Food Delivery App Development

items.title: Easy Onboarding
items.text: Users can quickly sign up and log in to start using the app. Single sign ons and social logins makes the onboarding a breeze through.

items.title: Nearby Restaurants
items.text: Users can search and find nearby restaurants that serve their favorite dishes by running a search enabled with geo-location.

items.title: Restaurant Menu
items.text: Option to view the restaurant menu online on the mobile app just like it would be presented by a smiling waiter at the restaurant.

items.title: Order Tracking
items.text: Be in the know of how long before the food will arrive at the user doorstep. GPS-enabled app ensures real-time info for users & admins.

items.title: Multiple Payment Options
items.text: Cash on delivery, debit/credit cards, online banking or food coupons - users can pay any way they wish.

items.title: Re-Order
items.text: Repeating a favorite order should not take time or energy. Reorder feature makes it easy for users to repeat previous orders.

items.title: Schedule Order
items.text: Schedule the order to be placed and delivered at a stipulated time and place most convenient to the user.

items.title: Takeaway Option
items.text: Order online, takeaway offline. Users can place orders from restaurants, pay for them and pick them up themselves.

items.title: Ratings & Reviews
items.text: General feedback from users can be collected and displayed in the form of text reviews and star ratings against each restaurant.

items.title: Promos & Offers
items.text: Promo codes, seasonal offers, coupon codes and several other innovative forms of incentives can be baked into the app.

items.title: Manage Profile
items.text: From display name to delivery addresses and everything in between like favorite payment mode, users can manage their profile in all ways.

items.title: Help & Support
items.text: One-touch help and support system that allows users to reach out to support team for immediate assistance.

items.title: Push Notifications
items.text: In-app push notifications that alert users of placed orders, completed orders, cancelled orders, new offers and much more.

items.title: Create Profile
items.text: Driver can create their unique profile complete with vehicle details, driving license number & contact details.

items.title: Availability Settings
items.text: Driver can toggle between available and unavailable status to take or reject upcoming deliver orders.

items.title: Receive Order
items.text: Drivers can receive orders and accept them for deliver to customer location even while processing another order.

items.title: Receive Delivery Location
items.text: The order will contain accurate location details of the customer that will help the driver locate them faster.

items.title: Receive Multiple Deliveries
items.text: Real-time location based order matching ensures that drivers can be assigned multiple deliveries at the same time.

items.title: Manage Orders
items.text: Depending on the ETA of each order, drivers can prioritise the delivery for each order.

items.title: Realtime Tracking
items.text: Track the time elapsed for each order on a real-time basis to ensure that orders are delivered without delays.

items.title: Delivery Status
items.text: Multiple options to update delivery status as completed, in progress, abandoned, or customer unavailable.

items.title: View Order History
items.text: A comprehensive view of the number of order delivered, cancelled, with timestamps.

items.title: Payment History
items.text: Drivers can keep a track of their total money collected and their individuals earnings from completed deliveries.

items.title: Notifications
items.text: Push notifications for new deliveries, canceled deliveries, change in delivery locations, and much more.

items.title: Help & Support
items.text: In-app support portal as well as emergency support that can help drivers reach out for immediate assistance.

items.title: Profile Creation
items.text: Restaurant owners can create unique profiles for their restaurants complete with images and videos.

items.title: Manage Business Info
items.text: Option to manage business info like working hours, location & contact details on the profile.

items.title: Manage Menu
items.text: Add, edit or remove dishes from the menu on a real-time basis. Pricing can also be updated from time-to-time.

items.title: Order Alerts
items.text: Restaurant admin can get alerts for new orders, upcoming orders or cancelled orders.

items.title: Manage Orders
items.text: Accept or reject orders depending on the working hours, staff availability and cooking time.

items.title: Payment Management
items.text: Multiple payment options including credit/debit cards, online banking, digital wallets, promo codes, etc.

items.title: Reply To Reviews
items.text: Restaurant owners can respond to reviews submitted by customers on their profiles.

items.title: Manage Promos
items.text: Release new promos, cancel ongoing ones, limit promos by time period or order numbers or set ceiling limits.

items.title: Get Insights
items.text: Know customer behaviour better by getting insights about frequently ordered dishes, location, time, etc.

items.title: Customer Details
items.text: Know more about the customer, their location and payment history to whom the delivery is to be dispatched.

items.title: Help & Support
items.text: In-app support portal as well as emergency support to find quick resolutions to issues within the app.

items.title: Track Order History
items.text: Restaurant admin can keep a real-time check on the order history to compute earnings and other key metrics.

items.title: Restaurant Management
items.text: Admins can add and manage multiple restaurants from a single admin profile.

items.title: Menu Management
items.text: Monitor menu pricing and edit menu items for multiple properties concurrently.

items.title: Customer Management
items.text: Maintain a detailed customer information index for improving service quality.

items.title: Order Management
items.text: Accept or reject orders. Prioritize orders for processing and delivery based on delivery personnel availability.

items.title: Payments & Commissions
items.text: Facility to configure various commission rates and payment modes for restaurants.

items.title: Feedback Management
items.text: Collect, manage and respond to customer feedback received. Block offensive users if needed.

items.title: Offers Management
items.text: A single window to manage all ongoing and upcoming offers. Ongoing offers can be linked to payment section for smooth checkouts.

items.title: Notifications Management
items.text: Create push notifications for new orders, dispatched orders, cancelled orders or completed orders.

items.title: Reporting & Analytics
items.text: Have a pulse of the business with real-time reporting and analytics that are displayed in the form of a dashboard.

items.title: Support
items.text: Support portal to reach out for immediate resolution of technical glitches, payment issues, etc.
